verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns classical simulation of low-depth quantum circuits via graphical-model/treewidth methods ('scales exponentially in the depth times the smaller lateral dimension, or the treewidth'), not topological entropy of boolean circuit dynamics. verdicts.title: Sample entropy of sEMG signals at different stages of rectal cancer treatment

verdicts.title: On estimating the entropy of shallow circuit outputs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Estimating the entropy of probability distributions and quantum states is a fundamental task in information processing. Here, we examine the hardness of this task for the case of probability distributions or quantum states produced by shallow circuits. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract addresses the computational hardness of estimating Shannon/von Neumann entropy of distributions or quantum states produced by shallow circuits ('entropy estimation ... is at least as hard as the Learning with Errors (LWE) problem'), not the topological entropy of a dynamical system induced by circuit computation. It neither bounds nor refutes any H(C) = O(α(n)) claim from topological dynamics.
